description: This file contains the implementation of the FreeCheckout class in PHP, which extends the system's model class for handling payment methods in the OpenCart system. It includes the getMethods function that retrieves available payment options based on the current cart status and configurations.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: A class representing a free checkout payment method in the OpenCart system, extending the core model class and providing functionality to retrieve available free checkout options.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available free checkout payment options based on cart totals, vouchers, and configuration settings.
